description: Header file declaring functions and constants for WiFi endpoint management in a private plugin, including hooks, connection, WPS, stats, and MLD configuration.

methods.name: wifiGen_ep_createHook
methods.description: Creates a hook for WiFi endpoint events.

methods.name: wifiGen_ep_destroyHook
methods.description: Destroys a previously created WiFi endpoint hook.

methods.name: wifiGen_ep_enable
methods.description: Enables or disables the WiFi endpoint.

methods.name: wifiGen_ep_connectAp
methods.description: Connects the endpoint to an access point.

methods.name: wifiGen_ep_disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects the endpoint from its current connection.

methods.name: wifiGen_ep_bssid
methods.description: Sets or retrieves the BSSID of the endpoint.

methods.name: wifiGen_ep_status
methods.description: Retrieves the current status of the endpoint.

methods.name: wifiGen_ep_wpsStart
methods.description: Starts WPS process with specified parameters.

methods.name: wifiGen_ep_multiApEnable
methods.description: Enables multi-AP mode for the endpoint.

methods.name: wifiGen_ep_sendManagementFrame
methods.description: Sends a management frame over WiFi.

methods.name: wifiGen_ep_setMacAddress
methods.description: Sets the MAC address of the endpoint.

methods.name: wifiGen_ep_connStatus
methods.description: Checks the connection status of the endpoint.

methods.name: wifiGen_ep_getConnChspec
methods.description: Gets the channel specification for the connection.

methods.name: wifiGen_ep_setMldUnit
methods.description: Configures the MLD unit for the endpoint, supporting MLO capabilities.
